name: Cyclops
description: Cyclopses can easily be recognized by the single eye located in the center of their foreheads.
story: How about this.. we take a big stake, sharpen its tip, jam it in the cyclops' eye — then sneak out of the cave disguised as sheep. How's that not a good idea? — Odess Thaka, traveler. Died tragically on Spikeroog
lore: Iffor some reason that is not visible, other tell-tale signs are their enormous size, incredible strength and a seething hatred for all humans.
habitat: Caves, mountain valleys, bridges, and remote roads
